pages.title: Mara Okafor, VP Product at Delphi Labs
pages.text: Mara Okafor is Vice President of Product at Delphi Labs, where she leads the payments and billing products. She joined in 2023. Before Delphi she was a product manager at Stripe from 2017 to 2022.

pages.title: ProductCon 2025: Mara Okafor
pages.text: Mara Okafor spoke at ProductCon 2025 on moving a subscription business to usage-based pricing. Her session covered metering, customer communication and how to measure the effect on retention.

pages.title: Interview: Mara Okafor on building payments products
pages.text: In an interview, Okafor said she moved to Delphi Labs to lead a small team end to end. She described her approach as writing a one-page memo before any build and meeting customers every week.
